svg.title: No Condorcet winner was knocked out; a handful came close
svg.desc: Strip chart of 601 divisions across 2016, 2019, 2022 and 2025. No point is below zero, which would be a centre squeeze. The closest each year is labelled; the shaded band is the 10-point at-risk zone.

g.text: No Condorcet winner was knocked out; a handful came close
The Condorcet winner's lead over the weaker of the other two, with three groups left, every House division
Condorcet winner's lead with three left (points)
